verdict.rationale: Canva documents an Apps SDK for bringing new design and editing experiences into the editor, and a public Apps Marketplace where those apps are distributed, so editor extensibility via a marketplace is a first-party capability. The pack does not show that the marketplace is large or community-driven, and it never mentions icon, data-filler or accessibility-checker apps specifically. missing for 10: evidence of marketplace size or community breadth, documented availability of icon, data-filler and accessibility-checker apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can extend the editor from a large plugin community or marketplace — icons, data fillers, accessibility checkers, and more

citations.quote: Use the Canva Apps SDK to bring new design and editing experiences into the Canva editor.
You can then either distribute the app publicly via the Apps Marketplace, or share it privately with members of your team.
You can use the Apps SDK to create apps that import content into Canva, add elements to a user's design, automate common design tasks, and more.
